description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and constants related to the RDK Shell framework, including input handling, application lifecycle, event management, and display controls. It includes abstract classes for implementation and event listeners, as well as macros and external function pointers for various control functions.

classes.name: RDKShellImpl
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for key code translation from Wayland input events.

classes.name: RDKShell
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to manage the shell, including application management, input, display, and event controls.

classes.name: RdkShellEvent
classes.description: Abstract class for receiving various application and device events.

classes.name: RdkShellData
classes.description: Container class with assignment operators to hold shell-related data, allowing flexible usage.

classes.name: RdkShellEventListener
classes.description: Base class for event listener implementations, with methods for different event callbacks.

classes.name: RdkShellEasterEggKeyDetails
classes.description: Structure representing key details for Easter Egg detection.

classes.name: RdkShellEasterEggDetails
classes.description: Details of an Easter Egg including key sequence, duration, and associated API.

classes.name: RdkShellApiImpl
classes.description: Interface defining the core API for RdkShell functionalities, such as RAM info, Easter Eggs, and display controls.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Provides static methods to control logging functionality.

classes.name: RdkShellApi
classes.description: Main interface for external control over the shell, including application lifecycle, input, display, and event management.

classes.name: CompositorControllerImpl
classes.description: Interface for controlling compositor and window management functions.

classes.name: CompositorController
classes.description: Static class exposing window and display controls, input handling, and application focus management.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Assigns implementation for the corresponding interface; used for dependency injection.

methods.name: addEasterEgg
methods.description: Registers an Easter Egg with specified key sequence and action.

methods.name: removeEasterEgg
methods.description: Removes a registered Easter Egg by name.

methods.name: getEasterEggs
methods.description: Retrieves the list of registered Easter Eggs.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RdkShell system.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Performs an update cycle for the shell.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Triggers rendering for the shell.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the system, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: systemRam
methods.description: Retrieves system memory statistics.

methods.name: setMemoryMonitor
methods.description: Configures memory monitoring with provided settings.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds an event listener to the shell.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes an event listener from the shell.

methods.name: launchApplication
methods.description: Launches an application with provided URI and MIME type, with options for focus and topmost.

methods.name: suspendApplication
methods.description: Suspends a running application.

methods.name: resumeApplication
methods.description: Resumes a suspended application.

methods.name: setMimeType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type for a specific client.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves the MIME type associated with a client.

methods.name: showSplashScreen
methods.description: Displays a splash screen for a defined duration.

methods.name: hideSplashScreen
methods.description: Hides the splash screen.

methods.name: setTopmost
methods.description: Sets the topmost window flag for a client.

methods.name: getTopmost
methods.description: Retrieves whether a client is topmost.

methods.name: isSurfaceModeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if surface mode is enabled.

methods.name: enableKeyRepeats
methods.description: Enables or disables key repeat functionality.

methods.name: getKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if key repeats are enabled.

methods.name: screenShot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the current display.

methods.name: getLastKeyPress
methods.description: Retrieves the last key press event details.

methods.name: ignoreKeyInputs
methods.description: Ignores or re-enables key input handling.

methods.name: setInactivityInterval
methods.description: Sets the inactivity interval in minutes.
